combo_label: At the Dentist × Silly English Things × The Tudors

entries.clue: Half-mercury alloy with silver, tin and copper, the old dark grey dental repair
Cloistered brother pensioned off when his house came down
Waxed thread you promise to use nightly, meant for the gaps a brush never reaches
Off true and faintly unreliable, as a knee or a broadband link may be
Rubber boots; in Yorkshire they hold contests for hurling one
Canterbury primate who framed the prayer book and burned at Oxford in 1556
Drawn-out treatment that clears a dying nerve from deep inside and seals the space
German duchy that sent the fourth wife, set aside again within the year
Religious house closed and stripped on the king's orders
Mid-morning pause for a biscuit, observed with great solemnity
